description: Ex-RNZAF B(I)12 NZ6109 bought second-hand in Nov 1980, IAF serial F1188 (Bharat Rakshak). Long displayed painted as IF-908 (an ONUC Congo veteran serial) in a PR-blue scheme; renovated and fenced by an AFS Lohegaon team in Dec 2003. Visible from Bund Garden Road. Coordinates from warbirds.in map tag. Identity per Ralph Lunt 1994 wing marking F1188; currency 2025 unverified.
